# AnantaSutra

> AnantaSutra embeds vetted, dedicated domain experts inside your team — you pay just the expert's salary, with no 30–50% agency markup. Experts are onboarded in about 7 days, backed by a 48-hour replacement guarantee, and you can scale up or pause anytime. Founded by Bhavya Duneja, based in Delhi, India, serving clients across 4 continents.

AnantaSutra's model in one line: one dedicated expert, embedded in your team, working only for you — a transparent alternative to agencies (which mark talent up 30–50% and split it across many clients), unreliable freelancers, and slow in-house hiring. "Not a project. A dedicated expert."

## How it works
- A 30-minute call on your business and the outcome you want.
- We hand-pick and vet 2–3 experts; you interview and choose.
- Your expert is embedded in your team (Slack/WhatsApp/standups) within about 7 days.
- Weekly reviews, monthly reports, and one accountable point of contact.
- Pricing: you pay the expert's actual salary plus a small, transparent coordination fee — no 30–50% agency markup, no recruitment fee, no lock-in, and a 48-hour replacement guarantee.
